mapper.select: SELECT id, student_id, name, age, college, created_at, updated_at FROM student ORDER BY id
SELECT s.id, s.student_id, s.name, s.age, s.college, s.created_at, s.updated_at, c.name AS college_name FROM student s LEFT JOIN college c ON s.college = c.id WHERE s.student_id = #{studentId}

SELECT s.id, s.student_id, s.name, s.age, s.college, s.created_at, s.updated_at, c.name AS college_name FROM student s LEFT JOIN college c ON s.college = c.id WHERE s.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%') ORDER BY s.id
